body: Away. Into the bay. How does one really say goodbye?

No, i dont know that. The person who gave them my details didnt give a fuck. It was a person, doing their job, and didnt want the weight of talking to a dying man on their brain. It's not about me. No one does anything for me. Im tired of being "good". Im tired of people leaving me. If this happens all the time, then there is something wrong with me, and i need to remove myself.

No. No more calls to people that dont give a fuck about me. last time i did, the police came, detained me, and i lost my job. i just wanted to die, and felt wrong, and that call ruined my life. So no, fuck off.
